subject: Observer Function Sensitivity to Placement of Triggers in Code - Potential Bug

messages.author: 10c8cda73c65d9b2
messages.subject: Observer Function Sensitivity to Placement of Triggers in Code - Potential Bug
parts:
I was troubleshooting my application this morning attempting to figure out why an action was not bring triggered.  This is the minimal code and it seems as if the specific placement of the triggers in the Server.R in the code does matter.  I was not sure whether this is a bug or if I am not understanding something basic.

UI
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel("My Title"),
   
    sidebarPanel
    (        
                fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV File',
                          accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv')),
                tags$hr(),
                checkboxInput('header', 'Header', TRUE),
                radioButtons('sep', 'Separator',
                             c(Comma=',',
                               Semicolon=';',
                               Tab='\t'),
                             'Comma'),
                radioButtons('quote', 'Quote',
                             c(None='',
                               'Double Quote'='"',
                               'Single Quote'="'"),
                             'Double Quote')                 
    ),

    mainPanel
    (
    )
))

Server
main_plot<<-NULL
    
shinyServer(function(input, output, session)
{
    triggers<-reactiveValues(mainplot1=1)
    
    datasetInputPre <- observe({
        inFile <- input$file1
        if (is.null(inFile)) return(NULL)
        if (is.na(inFile)[1]) return(NULL)
        main_plot<<-NULL

        triggers$fileType<-toupper(substr(inFile[1],max(gregexpr(".", inFile[1], fixed=TRUE)[[1]])+1,nchar(inFile[1])))
        
        main_plot<<-read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep, quote=input$quote)
        if (!is.null(main_plot)) triggers$mainplot1<-isolate(triggers$mainplot1+1)
    })
   

    updatexcol <- observe({
        triggers$mainplot1 #Placement of trigger here does execute.  The browser command below gets triggered 
        if (is.null(main_plot)) return (NULL)
        browser()
        triggers$mainplot1 #Placement of trigger here does not execute.  The browser command does not  get triggered 
        a<-1         
    })

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: Observer Function Sensitivity to Placement of Triggers in Code - Potential Bug
parts:
It's not a bug, it's by design.

When shiny runs the below version of updatexcol it reads until the line if(is.null(main_plot)) return(NULL) at this points since main_plot is NULL it stops there and doesn't know that it should depend on triggers$mainplot1. Basically shiny doesn't read ahead and build the dependencies, it builds dependencies as it executes code.

updatexcol <- observe({

if (is.null(main_plot)) return (NULL)
        browser()
        triggers$mainplot1 #Placement of trigger here does not execute.  The browser command does not  get triggered 
        a<-1         
    })
